paragraphs: Abba Yosi ben Yochanan of Jerusalem.
See the entry Abba Yosi ben Yochanan of Yenoach.[^1]

notes.text: ב״י in the target is completed as ben Yochanan from the exact full patronymic in this same notice, rather than from a familiar destination. Jerusalem and Yenoach remain different place designations; the cross-reference is not an independent identity binding. Abba is explicit in both occurrences.
